notes.title: Defending Lydia Collier v.0.17 Update Released!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/3ea6ae0b3e436394b1bc37ca88b0c776338dbd00.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Defending Lydia Collier v.0.17 Update![/h1][p][/p][p][b]Hello everybody![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Here is the full release of Defending Lydia Collier v.0.17![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Change Log:[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]2375 new renders and three new animations, adding in a whole new day of content![/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]New scenes with:[/i][/p][p][i]Helena,
Ellie,
Ellie & Lydia,
Jenna,
Lydia,
Bimbo Stephanie,
Regular Stephanie,
Bimbo Steph & Lydia.[/i][/p][p][i]Along with new story content![/i][/p][p][i]Updates the engine to Ren'Py 7.8.4 which should fix the issues Mac users were having.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]I've tested through this many times and fixed any bugs reported during the BETA, I'll be double checking them all and if I have missed any, fixing them for v.0.17.1.[/p][p][/p][p]I've also played through all the paths and everything seems to be running smoothly, but there's so many variables in the game my save files do not cover them all, so if you do get any bugs please report them via Discord.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What's Next?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]There will be another update in about a week's time (v.0.17.1) changing a lot of coding to do with the computer, which I am almost finished with, adding in the new achievements, adding in a Tiffany gallery page, and implementing the in-game walkthrough.[/p][p][/p][p]I couldn't fully implement the in-game walkthrough without messing with the in-game computer and it just put bugs everywhere with the custom UI screen I made, so I'm going to remove the one selection screen where you click the people for the missions and take it to a standard Ren'Py choice screen that I can add the walkthrough to.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll also be adding in some custom audio for the builders, train and tunnel with v.0.17.1 to polish the update off, but all the new renders and content for this update is now there.[/p][p][/p][p][b]I hope you all enjoy the update, and thanks for all the new and continued support![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]WP[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Defending Lydia Collier v.0.15.9 Update Released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43138987/a057322e6d90f077e2b79bb44f6fd99c42eaac6c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Defending Lydia Collier v.0.15.9 Released![/h1]

[i]Please note, this is an Alpha update and it has not yet been thoroughly tested! Please keep your current saves in case anything goes wrong, and if you do encounter bugs please report them in Discord and they will be very swiftly fixed.[/i]

Defending Lydia Collier v.0.15.9 adds in a new day focused on Jenna and Lydia, along with expanding the game's core story with several new scenes involving the Player and the TITAN Officers.

[i]This update features:

800+ New Renders!

5 New Animations!

An entire new day with Jenna, with two different branching paths based on Player choices!

New Story Scenes!

Multiple Bug Fixes.[/i]

Excluding any bug fixes if required, the next update will be Ellie and Lydia's evening together which will be released in April!

[b]I hope you enjoy this update and thank you for all your patience.

WP[/b]

notes.title: v.0.15.2 - Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/fMXF8wq/stephmechanic.jpg[/img]

[h1]Minor update fixing several bugs.[/h1]

[b]Saves made with errors, typically caused by ignoring a Ren'Py Error, continuing with the game and then saving with the game in an error state, will now open a bug screen to prevent the save being used.[/b]

[i]I appreciate this may be irritating if you didn't know you had saved the game in an error state, however this is the cause all of the "NoneType" and "VPGrill Full" errors that have been popping up and was necessary to prevent future crashes and bugs. If you do encounter a Ren'Py Error, you must roll back and save before it, ignoring it and continuing will cause bugs down the line.[/i]

[b]Removed the "voice" slider from the options as it was redundant and the other sliders control all audio.[/b]

[b]Fixed errors in the Quick Save Menu Buttons.[/b]
